content: According to The Post and Courier, the Department of the Air Force has begun the process of renaming Joint Base Charleston in honor of the late Sen. Lindsey Graham. An internal July 27 memorandum from Air Force Secretary Troy Meink directs officials to begin taking the necessary steps to redesignate the installation as Joint Base Lindsey Graham, citing the senator's decades of service in both the U.S. Air Force and Congress. Graham, who served 33 years in the Air Force and Air National Guard, was one of Joint Base Charleston's strongest advocates on Capitol Hill, helping secure hundreds of millions of dollars for infrastructure, modernization, and Coast Guard expansion. The base is home to the nation's largest fleet of C-17 Globemaster III cargo aircraft. Source: postandcourier.com/politics/… Nick Reynolds (@IAmNickReynolds) Scoop: "The Pentagon is taking steps to rename Joint Base Charleston after Air Force veteran the late U.S. Sen. 6 Şubat depremleri sürecinde sosyal medya fenomeni, sanatçısı, oyuncusu, gazetecisi, siyasetçisiyle çok farklı kesimlerin bir yıpratma savaşına müdahil olduğunu, âdeta aynı merkezden düğmeye basılmışçasına topa girdiğini gördük. Devlet olarak bir taraftan tüm imkânlarımızla afetzedelerimizin yardımına koşarken diğer taraftan da bu çevrelerce köpürtülen dezenformasyonla mücadele etmek zorunda kaldık. Son haftalarda ortaya dökülen bilgi ve belgeler, 53 binden fazla canımızı toprağa verdiğimiz 6 Şubat depremleri sürecinde neler yaşandığını, hangi oyunların çevrildiğini, devlete ve millete hangi operasyonların çekildiğini, deprem bölgesine ayak basmamış terbiye yoksunu tiplerin nasıl hariçten gazel okuduğunu hepimize çok net biçimde gösteriyor. Kimlerin kimlerle hangi çarpık ilişkiler içinde olduğu tek tek ortaya çıkıyor. Aynı zamanda bunların hesabı yargımız tarafından soruluyor. Depremi kullanarak siyasi ve ekonomik fırsatçılık yapanlar bugün adalete hesap veriyor. Bir defa şunun bilinmesini isterim: “Suimisalin emsal olmaması” için hukuk zemininde ne gerekiyorsa mutlaka yapacağız. Bunda son derece kararlıyız. Ucu nereye varırsa varsın, bundan böyle bu ülkede gerilimden, kutuplaşmadan, korku ve kaygı yaymaktan medet umanların ellerindeki imkânları devlete karşı bir silah olarak kullanmalarına fırsat vermeyeceğiz.

Dezenformasyonun her çeşidiyle mücadeleyi ülkemiz, demokrasimiz ve toplumsal barışımız açısından bir millî güvenlik meselesi olarak görüyoruz. Çünkü günümüzde dezenformasyon yanlış bilgi yaymanın ötesine geçmiş; biz dâhil toplumların birlik ve güven duygusunu zayıflatan, demokrasileri tehdit eden asimetrik bir unsura dönüşmüştür. Dezenformasyonla mücadelemizi bu anlayışla meselenin taşıdığı hayati önem doğrultusunda kararlılıkla sürdüreceğiz.

When you look inside a reactor’s core, do you notice that captivating blue glow? That is the ‘Cherenkov effect’ at work! It is named after the physicist who was born #onthisday in 1904. While studying the effects of radiation emitted by sources such as radium, passing through various fluids, Pavel Cherenkov observed a blue-ish light emitted by a radioactive source placed in water. This phenomenon was later explained by Igor Tamm and Ilya Frank: charged particles are disturbing electrons as the particles move faster than the speed of light in the insulating medium like water. This is the ‘Cherenkov effect,’ and he along with Tamm and Frank earned the 1958 @NobelPrize in Physics "for the discovery and the interpretation of the Cherenkov effect". 🔗atoms.iaea.org/4fyYErJ Video

The public execution of two protesters in Iran today marks a further escalation of authorities’ use of the death penalty to quash dissent. They were sentenced to death following a grossly unfair mass trial that concerned the killing of four police agents as well as allegations of damage to public property and arson. The executions only add to the surge in arbitrary death sentences and executions since the restoration of internet access in May. We have documented protesters being sentenced to death for offences such as property damage, arson, road blockages and disrupting public opinion, acts that should not carry the death penalty according to international law and standards. Convictions have been issued in closed, grossly unfair proceedings marred by enforced disappearance, torture and other ill-treatment, and denial of access to a lawyer.

Make healthy lifestyle changes to help prevent or delay type 2 diabetes by: · Eating healthier · Being more physically active · Losing weight if recommended What you can do today: Take CDC's 1-minute Prediabetes Risk Test at DoIHavePrediabetes.org and talk with your doctor if you're at risk. #SharkWeek #ChronicDisease #PrediabetesRisk #KnowYourRisk

Sharks get a lot of attention. But some of the biggest threats to your health don’t live in the ocean. Heart disease, cancer, obesity, and diabetes are among the leading causes of illness, disability, and death in the United States. Many chronic diseases share common risk factors. Healthy habits, along with routine preventive care and recommended screenings, can help reduce your risk. This Shark Week, take a moment to think beyond the beach. Knowing your health risks is an important step toward protecting your long-term health. What you can do: Talk with your doctor about your health risks, family health history, and the preventive care and screenings that are right for you. #SharkWeek #ChronicDisease #KnowYourRisk

How can food systems create economic opportunity? Food is essential to nutrition, health and well-being. For millions of rural people, it is also a source of livelihood. When agricultural production is effectively marketed, processed and traded, it can generate income, create jobs and drive broader rural transformation. In Cambodia, IFAD’s ASPIRE programme has supported this transition. One example is Kampot pepper – a geographical indication product now reaching international markets, including Germany, where its recognized value has opened new opportunities for small-scale producers. Between 2014 and 2022, ASPIRE reached more than 143,000 households, helping farmers move from informal local trading to more structured commercial relationships. IFAD impact assessments show that participating farmers increased market sales volumes by 41% on average and incomes by more than 50%. By strengthening productivity and market linkages, the programme helped build a value chain connecting Cambodian small-scale producers to both domestic and export markets. Since 2017, IFAD-supported cooperatives have supplied Kampot pepper to Germany’s Fuchs Group, Europe’s largest spice manufacturer – enabling farmers to secure more competitive prices, reduce uncertainty and plan production more effectively. Saurav Das (@SauravDassss) 🚨URGENT STATEMENT🚨 The interim order passed by the Supreme Court of India in the batch of PILs related to the CJP protest must ring alarm bells across the country. In particular, Direction No. 4, which permits governments to proceed with existing FIRs and carry out investigations, raises extremely serious concerns. This direction stands in direct contradiction to the solemn assurance and guarantee extended by the Government of India to the youth of this nation on 25 July 2026, namely, that the FIRs would be withdrawn and that no protester would be directly or indirectly targeted for participating in the peaceful movement. It was on the strength of that solemn assurance, and in complete good faith, that the Cockroach Janta Party called off its nationwide protest. We now have a credible apprehension that the Government of India and BJP-ruled states may seek to use and weaponise this order of the Bench led by Chief Justice of India Surya Kant to continue FIRs against individual protesters and subject them to great harassment. This was precisely our concern from day one: that courts could be used, directly or indirectly, to achieve political ends by targeting peaceful dissent. Equally troubling is the fact that the interim order was not opposed by the government's lawyers, despite the Central Government being fully aware that talks/assurances with the CJP had continued until as recently as late last night and that a solemn agreement had already been arrived at on 25 July. The court's uninformed order is therefore wholly unacceptable. A solemn public assurance given to thousands of young students and protesters cannot be diluted, undermined, or rendered meaningless through subsequent legal developments, in a surreptitious manner. It only results in breach of public trust. In any event, nothing in the interim order prevents the Government of India or the concerned BJP/NDA ruled State Governments from withdrawing the FIRs or deciding not to proceed against peaceful protesters, like done by Bihar and Assam governments. The power to withdraw or not pursue such cases continues to rest with the executive. The court has not mandated that governments must definitely continue with the FIRs. That would be a deliberate misreading. The Government must not invoke the Court’s order as a justification for reneging on the commitment it made on 25 July. We therefore demand that the Government of India and the concerned BJP/NDA State Governments immediately place the terms of this solemn assurance before the Supreme Court in the pending proceedings so that there is complete transparency regarding the commitments already made to the youth of this country and so that the court can withdraw and make an informed order in the future. The youth of India entered into this understanding in good faith. That good faith must not be betrayed. Institutions of constitutional importance must never be politicised and weaponised to not honour the guarantees. The deadline for the Government of India to honour its guarantees expires today. We once again call upon it to fulfil every commitment it made: withdraw the FIRs, ensure that no protester is subjected to future punitive action, and honour both the letter and the spirit of the assurance that brought an end to the protest. Failing this, and as previously declared, the Cockroach Janta Party will have no option but to resume its nationwide protest to protect the students and young protesters who stood up not for themselves alone, but for the future of this nation. A government that breaks its word cannot expect the youth to remain silent. If the guarantees are dishonoured, the streets of India will once again become the voice of its young. — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/SauravDassss/status/2082102918887694624#m

Positive Headline of the Day! Massive plantation drive strengthens Assam's Green Mission in Tamulpur.. Reaffirming the pledge to protect the environment, the 64th Battalion of the Sashastra Seema Bal (SSB) conducted a massive tree plantation drive at Delaisri Picnic Spot in Bogajuli under Tamulpur district. The initiative, carried out under the theme of environmental conservation saw the plantation of 520 saplings with the active participation of SSB personnel, the Assam Forest Department and local stakeholders reflecting a shared commitment towards building a greener and more sustainable future. As we continue to strengthen environmental conservation across Assam, our focus remains on increasing green cover, restoring ecological balance and encouraging greater public participation in protecting nature. Collaborative initiatives involving security forces, government agencies and local communities are playing an important role in preserving the state's rich natural heritage while promoting environmental awareness. Organised on July 27 under the leadership of Commandant Anuj Kumar of the 64th Battalion, SSB, Barama, the plantation drive witnessed the enthusiastic participation of personnel from the Patkijuli and Daranga Border Outposts. During the programme, 520 saplings of valuable and fruit-bearing species were planted to enhance biodiversity, improve the local environment and contribute to long-term ecological sustainability. Beyond planting trees, the officers and jawans took a collective pledge to nurture and protect every sapling, recognising that conservation is a long-term commitment. The initiative also aimed to inspire local residents and visitors to adopt environmentally responsible practices and actively participate in safeguarding nature. Our vision is to build a cleaner, greener and more climate-resilient Assam through collective action. Every plantation drive strengthens our commitment to environmental stewardship, proving that when institutions, communities and citizens work together, they can create a lasting legacy of sustainability for future generations. #JayantaMallabaruah

Honored to join sheriffs from across the state of Florida today for a candid conversation about the issues that matter most to the communities they serve and how this FBI can better support the men and women doing the work on the ground. That partnership is already delivering results. Violent crime is down nearly 20% nationwide, and in Florida alone, it is down more than 13%. We discussed expanding Rapid DNA beyond its current use across just four criminal violations so state and local officers can identify violent offenders faster. We have already seen what this technology can do. During Operation Turf War in Martinsburg, West Virginia, mobile Rapid DNA helped investigators connect evidence to offenders in real time as the FBI and our partners arrested 35 gang members on firearms and narcotics offenses. We also cleared the TFO backlog, reduced administrative burdens and bureaucracy, and established the Law Enforcement Partner Engagement Council to create direct connectivity with the state and local partners who rely on FBI resources every day. And we are investing in the next generation by adding 50 seats to our National Academy classes and expanding counter-UAS training for major events through the National Counter-UAS Training Center, which resumes classes August 1 after surging resources to help secure the 2026 World Cup. This is how the FBI should operate: listen to our partners, cut the bureaucracy, put proven tools in their hands, and deliver results for the American people. -DKP 🇺🇸

The AMF is supported by the German Federal Government through GIZ cooperation project.

Everyone is talking about stealth fighters. Almost nobody is talking about the system that actually wins wars. Modern air combat isn’t fighter vs fighter. It’s sensor vs sensor. Network vs network. Kill Web vs Kill Web. Satellites. AWACS. Mountain radars. Drones. Electronic warfare. Air defence. Precision missiles. Naval strike groups. Individually, they’re powerful. Connected together, they become a Kill Web. That’s why the question isn’t: “How stealthy is the J-20?” The real question is: Can any aircraft survive a fully integrated, multi-domain Kill Web? 🎬 My latest 100-second documentary explores how modern air warfare is changing—and why networks, not individual platforms, will define the next conflict. Inspired by my book, Air Warfare in the Network Age, the documentary brings the concepts of the Kill Web, network-centric warfare, and next-generation air power to life through cinematic visuals. Osan Air Base, South Korea, has confirmed a "ground mishap" and established a 1,000-foot safety cordon around the incident, stating that reports claiming the base was being evacuated are false. According to Reuters, the incident involves white phosphorus, a military material commonly used in smoke screens and incendiary munitions. However, Osan Air Base's statement does not identify the material involved or provide details on the nature or cause of the mishap. At this time, no injuries have been announced and the base has not indicated to what degree the incident has affected normal operations.

Axios reports that senior Trump administration officials believe sustained economic pressure may ultimately inflict more damage on Iran than an expanded bombing campaign, pointing to growing signs of financial strain inside the country. According to Axios, U.S. officials cite intelligence indicating Iran is struggling to fund proxy forces, facing gasoline shortages, and under increasing financial pressure from sanctions led by Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent. Officials argue those economic measures, combined with a U.S. naval blockade, could prove more effective over time than additional airstrikes. Axios also reports Iran continues to seek sanctions relief and access to frozen assets through indirect talks mediated by Oman, Qatar, and Pakistan, while the Trump administration insists any agreement must also address Tehran's remaining nuclear material. The report notes President Trump's decision to pause strikes followed military concerns over air defense interceptor stockpiles but says officials characterize those warnings as a risk assessment rather than the primary driver of the decision. Eduardo spat for the fifth time in seven years on Wednesday, and the recipient had a drone. You need to know what the count means before the drone matters. An alpaca's spit is not saliva. It is the contents of one of three forestomach chambers, brought back up the oesophagus and delivered about three metres with the accuracy of a man throwing a dart at a wall he is leaning against. It carries partly fermented grass, gastric acid at somewhere near pH 2, and a smell that people on the receiving end describe as permanent. It does not come out of fabric. It does not come out of hair. It does not come out of the memory. Four times in seven years. A fox. A stray dog. A journalist who got too close to the smaller ones. A man from the council, who did come back, but in sealed eyewear. That is the entire system. He almost never has to. On Wednesday a man was flying a drone from the footpath, low, in passes, the way they do once they have found something photogenic. The flock bunched. The orphan lamb, who thinks it is an alpaca, went and stood at Eduardo's shoulder with its ears flat, being no help whatsoever. Eduardo watched two passes. Then he walked, unhurried, across sixty metres of field to the fence line nearest the man. He did not spit at the drone. There is no teaching a drone anything. He spat at the operator. The drone came down in the hedge. The man went back to his car at a pace suggesting he had reconsidered a number of things, and somewhere on the road home he will have understood that it is not going to wash out, that he is going to have to explain it, and that no version of the explanation does him any credit at all. Eduardo went back to the geometric centre of the field and hummed once. He has never yet had to do it twice to the same person.

Transit patterns diverge #MarineTraffic data highlights diverging patterns across two of the world's most strategically important maritime chokepoints. Between 24 and 26 July, the Strait of Hormuz recorded 29 verified crossings, including 21 vessels exiting the Middle East Gulf and 8 entering. Routing remained evenly split, with 14 transits using the Iranian Unilateral Scheme, 14 classified as Route Undetermined, and one using the Hormuz Traffic Separation Scheme. By comparison, Bab el-Mandeb recorded 100 verified crossings, with 51 vessels entering the Red Sea and 49 exiting. Ninety vessels followed the Traffic Separation Scheme, while 10 completed dark transits. Several vessels that had previously delayed or reversed course later completed their crossings, suggesting operators are continuing to assess risk dynamically rather than avoiding the route altogether. Amazing Sama Hoole (@SamaHoole) The last overseas shearers Britain intends to let in are on the fells right now, working out the final weeks of their leave. The door shut on 30 June. No vote, no debate, no announcement, just a date passing quietly in a summer when everyone was looking elsewhere. Those still working the Borders this week are here on leave that expires on 1 October, and when they fly out that is the end of it. Understand what is walking out. Six New Zealanders spent three months in one Northumberland valley last year and sheared nearly 90,000 sheep. Fifteen thousand head each, across farms from the Scottish Borders down to County Durham. They have been coming into Coquetdale for over thirty years. Since 2011 a concession has let up to 75 of them in each spring, and between them they take the wool off one and a half to two million British sheep in a window a few weeks long. The Home Office rejected the application on 2 February. Twenty-six days of farmers writing to their MPs got it reinstated on 10 March for one final year, with a line about the sector having had fourteen years to train British workers and now being expected to transition to domestic labour. Here is what that sentence is standing on. British Wool trains over 800 people a year, most of those courses are basic level, and most of the people on them are sheep farmers learning to do their own flock. Training was never the bottleneck. A top shearer clears a ewe in two or three minutes, calm hands, no panic in the animal, hundreds a day for weeks on end, and reaching that standard takes years of conditioning and a place in a global trade that follows the season around the planet. Fourteen million breeding ewes. A few weeks to do them all. A sheep left in fleece gets eaten alive by maggots, so the job is not optional and the date is not negotiable. Next spring those farms make phone calls that nobody answers. Seventy-five shearers, once a year, and a government that could not find room for them. — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/SamaHoole/status/2081819072086319404#m

این ڈی ایم اے، پی ڈی ایم ایز اور صوبائی حکومتوں کے ساتھ مسلسل رابطے میں رہے. تمام ادارے جاری مون سون کے نتیجے میں کسی بھی ہنگامی صورتحال سے نمٹنے کیلئے ہر دم تیار رہیں. این ڈی ایم اے تمام وفاقی و صوبائی اداروں کو مون سون کی صورتحال اور متوقع بارشوں کی اطلاعات بروقت پہنچائیں. وفاقی وزیرِ منصوبہ بندی روزانہ کی بنیادوں پر فلڈ کمیٹی کے اجلاس کی صدارت کریں اور صورتحال کے جائزے کے بعد لائحہ عمل طے کریں. شمالی علاقہ جات میں گلوف و طوفانی ریلوں کے حوالے سے پیشگی اطلاعات کے نظام کو بھرپور طریقے سے فعال رکھا جائے. وزیرِ اعظم نے گفتگو میں کہا پاکستان کا ماحول دشمن گیسوں کے اخراج میں حصہ معمولی ہے مگر موسمیاتی تبدیلی کے مضر اثرات پاکستان کو بری طرح متاثر کر رہے ہیں. موسمیاتی تبدیلی کے مضر اثرات کے پیش نظر حکومت طویل، وسط اور قلیل مدتی اقدامات پر تیزی سے کام کر رہی ہے. این ڈی ایم اے تمام اداروں کے تعاون سے یہ یقینی بنائے کہ مون سون کے جاری اسپیل میں جانی و مالی نقصان کو روکا جائے. اجلاس کو این ڈی ایم اے، گلگت بلتستان و آزاد کشمیر سمیت چاروں صوبوں کے چیف سیکریٹریز نے حالیہ مون سون اور اس کے نتیجے میں نقصانات، ریسکیو و بحالی کے اقدامات پر بریفنگ دی. اجلاس کو بتایا گیا کہ این ڈی ایم اے ملک کے شمالی علاقوں میں مون سون سے پیدا ہونے والی سیلابی صورتحال اور سندھ و بلوچستان میں جاری گرمی کی شدید لہر کے حوالے سے صوبائی حکومتوں و اداروں کو تمام تر معاونت و وسائل فراہم کر رہا ہے. آئندہ دو روز میں آزاد کشمیر و گلگت بلتستان اور جنوبی سندھ میں مون سون بارشوں کے ایک بڑے اسپیل کی توقع ہے. اس کے علاوہ ستمبر کے دوسرے ہفتے سے ملک بھر میں مون سون کا ایک بڑا سپیل بھی متوقع ہے. وزیرِ اعظم کی ہدایت پر قائم کردہ فلڈ کمیٹی کا اجلاس باقائدگی سے منعقد ہو رہا ہے جس میں تمام متعلقہ ادارے موجودہ صورتحال پر کڑی نظر رکھنے کے ساتھ ساتھ ریسکیو و ریلیف اور بحالی کے اقدامات کا جامع لائحہ عمل مرتب کرکے اسکا نفاذ یقینی بنا رہے ہیں. اجلاس کو مزید بتایا گیا کہ موجودہ مون سون اسیپل مین اب تک 110 اموات جبکہ 360 لوگ زخمی ہوئے، 796 مکانات کو نقصان پہنچا جبکہ 376 مویشی ہلاک ہوئے. اجلاس کو باتایا گیا کہ عالمی سطح پر جاری ایل-نینو (El-Nino) کی وجہ سے پاکستان کے شمالی علاقہ جات میں موجود گلیشیئرز کے پگھلنے کے تناسب میں اضافہ ہوا ہے جسکی وجہ سے آئندہ ایک ماہ میں گلوف و سیلابی ریلوں کا خطرہ لاحق ہے. ممکنہ طور پر متاثرہ علاقوں کی نشاندہی کرکے تمام تر حفاظتی اقدامات اٹھائے جا رہے ہیں. اجلاس کو بتایا گیا کہ وسطی پنجاب بشمول لاہور میں شہری سیلابی صورتحال پر قابو پانے کیلئے فوری اقدامات اٹھائے گئے جبکہ کچھ علاقوں میں برساتی نالوں میں سیلابی ریلوں کی وجہ سے زرعی زمین زیر آب ہے جس سے نکاسی کا کام جاری ہے. ڈیرہ غازی خان اور اس ملحقہ علاقوں میں بھی سیلابی ریلوں کی صورتحال اس وقت قابو میں ہے. اجلاس کو این ایچ اے کی جانب سے مٹی کے تودے گرنے سے سڑکوں کی بندش اور انکی بحالی پر بھی بریفنگ دی گئی. اجلاس کو بتایا گیا کہ 106 مقامات پر سڑکوں کی بندش کو بروقت اقدامات سے بحال کر دیا گیا ہے. اجلاس کو بتایا گیا کہ وزارت آئی ٹی کی جانب سے نیشنل ایمرجنسی و ٹیلی کمیونیکیشن سینٹر فعال ہے. کسی بھی موبائل فون سے ہنگامی صورتحال میں مدد کی کال پر فوری طور پر ریسکیو 1122 فعال ہوکر ریسکیو و ریلیف اقدامات کیلئے موقع پر پہنچتی ہے. مون سون کے دوران برساتی پانی کو سٹور کرنے کے لئے ملک کے مختلف مقامات پر 700 مقامات کی نشاندہی کی گئی ہے، تاکہ خشک موسم کے دوران وہ پانی زراعت کے لئے استعمال کیا جاسکے۔ بریفنگ وزیرِ اعظم نے این ڈی ایم اے، پی ڈی ایم ایز، صوبائی حکومتوں اور تمام متعلقہ اداروں کی حالیہ مون سون کی پیشگی اطلاعات، تیاری اور ریسکیو و ریلیف کے اقدامات پر پزیرائی کی. اجلاس میں وفاقی وزراء خواجہ محمد آصف، احسن اقبال، اعظم نذیر تارڑ، ڈاکٹر مصدق ملک، رانا تنویر حسین، محمد اورنگزیب، انجینئیر امیر مقام، عطاء اللہ تارڑ، شزہ فاطمہ خواجہ، سردار اویس خان لغاری، میاں محمد معین وٹو، مشیر وزیرِ اعظم رانا ثناء اللہ، چیئرمین این ڈی ایم اے لیفٹینینٹ جنرل انعام حیدر ملک اور متعلقہ اعلی حکام نے شرکت کی. Prof. (Dr.) M. Srinivas, Member (Health), NITI Aayog, attended the AIIMS Symposium on "Lifestyle & Diet: Nutrition, Wellness and Clinical Practice" as the Chief Guest. Organised by the Department of Physiology, AIIMS New Delhi, the symposium brought together experts to deliberate on the role of nutrition and lifestyle in improving health outcomes. Delivering the keynote address, Prof. (Dr.) Srinivas highlighted that India is facing a triple burden of malnutrition, comprising persistent undernutrition, micronutrient deficiencies, and the rising prevalence of overweight, obesity, and diet-related non-communicable diseases (NCDs). He emphasised the need to strengthen nutrition education, routine screening, behaviour change initiatives, and research and surveillance to support evidence-based policymaking. Reiterating that a healthier population is fundamental to achieving the vision of Viksit Bharat by 2047, he called for a comprehensive and preventive approach to improving public health. #PMOIndia #PreventiveHealthcare #Nutrition @PMOIndia @narendramodi @Rao_InderjitS @MIB_India @PIB_India @DDNewslive @ashoklahiribjp

When you look inside a reactor’s core, do you notice that captivating blue glow? That is the ‘Cherenkov effect’ at work! It is named after the physicist who was born #onthisday in 1904. While studying the effects of radiation emitted by sources such as radium, passing through various fluids, Pavel Cherenkov observed a blue-ish light emitted by a radioactive source placed in water. This phenomenon was later explained by Igor Tamm and Ilya Frank: charged particles are disturbing electrons as the particles move faster than the speed of light in the insulating medium like water. This is the ‘Cherenkov effect,’ and he along with Tamm and Frank earned the 1958 @NobelPrize in Physics "for the discovery and the interpretation of the Cherenkov effect". 🔗atoms.iaea.org/4fyYErJ Video

Upton Sinclair is also responsible for something else that passes without notice in our lives: the way we use shirt collars to talk about class. About fifteen years after publishing The Jungle, Sinclair wrote "The Brass Check," which was a muckraking expose on American newsrooms. In it, he described the office clerks upstairs as wearing white collar dress shirts, while the people in the mailroom below as wearing blue collar button-ups. This taxonomic shorthand — white collar vs blue collar — would become a popular way for writers to sidestep the uncomfortable discussion of class throughout the 20th century. Sinclair suggested that the ability to wear a white dress shirt allowed office clerks and middle managers to see themselves as socially distinct from laborers, even if they shared similar interests. An excerpt: "It is a fact with which every union workingman is familiar, that his most bitter despisers are the petty underlings of the business world, the poor office-clerks, who are often the worst exploited of proletarians, but who, because they are allowed to wear a white collar and to work in the office with the boss, regard themselves as members of the capitalist class." Of course, there were other dynamics at the time, such as race, but this taxonomic device (white collar, blue collar) continues to be popular today, especially in a post-industrial economy. Разом з помийкою "Трухою" на мене до суду також має подати і громадянин РФ Сеяр Куршутов. Це той, який за даними медіа заробляв на держконтрактах в МО до приходу Федорова Х2 від ринкової вартості дронів, організувавши схему завищення ціни через перепродаж комплектуючих своїм фірмам-прокладкам. БЕБ розслідує кримінальне провадження № 72025001420000026 щодо цього, але підозр досі чомусь нема. Куршутов під санкціями. Його ІПН бʼється в російських реєстрах. Він хоче далі красти бюджетні кошти, тому атакує. Як і "Труха", що служить корупціонерам і русні. Для мене за честь мати таких ворогів.

Бачу, як помийка "Труха" не заспокоюється, і ширить фейки проти мене та звинувачує у офіційній сплаті податків. Так, на відміну від помийки, я податки плачу. Ютуб приносить мені дохід, як і ФОП, і я не ховаю це від податкової. Ще й своїх майже 11 млн грн на армію задонатив. При цьому "Труха" активно просуває наратив, що не можна донатити і допомагати армії. Чому? Це формальний власник «Трухи» фунт Микола Удянський в компанії братів Асхабових у Харкові та на Балі разом з іншими кадирівцями. Брати Асхабови — вихованці клубу «Ахмат», які публічно називали своїм «шефом» Рамзана Кадирова (фото 3-4 — якраз вони з Кадировим). У центрі першого фото — члени ОЗУ Залютінські, які тероризували харківських фермерів. У 2021 році їх затримали у справі про вимагання $700 тис. у місцевого фермера. Цікаві друзі в Удянського. А ще цікавіші його власники.

Думаю, всі вже бачили нове інтерв’ю президента. На жаль, у ньому ми так і не отримали відповідь на питання, яке ставлять люди на протестах по всій країні. Я переконаний, що слухати свій народ – це ознака сили, і сподіваюсь, що президент таки нас почує. Адже без повноцінної комунікації в суспільстві наростатимуть фрустрація і зневіра, а це точно не те, з чим нам варто заходити в і так надважку зиму. Запрошую всіх в цю п'ятницю, 31 липня, о 19:00 у Києві доєднатися до протестної ходи за діалог і реформи в оборонці. •⁠ ⁠старт: пам'ятник Шевченку в парку Шевченка •⁠ ⁠фініш: площа Івана Франка Пропоную іншим містам також організовувати протестні ходи центральними вулицями, якщо це дозволятиме безпекова ситуація. বিস্তারিত: বাংলাদেশিদের জন্য মালয়েশিয়ার শ্রমবাজার দ্রুত পুনঃউন্মুক্ত ও কর্মী নিয়োগ প্রক্রিয়া সহজীকরণের লক্ষ্যে উভয় দেশের মধ্যে এক উচ্চপর্যায়ের বৈঠক অনুষ্ঠিত হয়েছে। মঙ্গলবার (২৮ জুলাই) পুত্রজায়ায় মালয়েশিয়ার মানবসম্পদ মন্ত্রণালয় এবং বাংলাদেশের প্রতিনিধিদলের মধ্যে এই গুরুত্বপূর্ণ দ্বিপাক্ষিক আলোচনা সম্পন্ন হয়। বৈঠকে বাংলাদেশের পক্ষে প্রবাসী কল্যাণ ও বৈদেশিক কর্মসংস্থান মন্ত্রী আরিফুল হক চৌধুরী এবং প্রধানমন্ত্রীর উপদেষ্টা মাহদী আমিন উপস্থিত ছিলেন। আলোচনায় উভয় দেশের অভ্যন্তরীণ চাহিদা ও দ্বিপাক্ষিক স্বার্থের কথা বিবেচনা করে কর্মী পাঠানোর বিভিন্ন ধাপ, সময়সীমা এবং নির্দিষ্ট কার্যপদ্ধতি (এসওপি) নিয়ে বিস্তারিত পর্যালোচনা করা হয়। মালয়েশিয়ার মানবসম্পদমন্ত্রী আর রামানান এক বিবৃতিতে জানিয়েছেন, আগামী কয়েক দিনের মধ্যেই শ্রমবাজার চালুর বিষয়ে চূড়ান্ত ও আনুষ্ঠানিক ঘোষণা আসতে পারে। বৈঠকে দুই দেশের কৌশলগত প্রয়োজন ও অর্থনৈতিক চাহিদাকে অগ্রাধিকার দিয়ে বিদ্যমান প্রক্রিয়াকে আরও গতিশীল করার ওপর জোর দেওয়া হয়। চলতি বছরের শেষ পর্যন্ত বিদ্যমান সমঝোতা স্মারকের (এমওইউ) মেয়াদ থাকলেও, নিছক চুক্তির আনুষ্ঠানিকতার চেয়ে বাস্তব পরিস্থিতির প্রেক্ষাপটে শ্রমবাজার উন্মুক্ত করাকেই এখন মূল অগ্রাধিকার হিসেবে দেখা হচ্ছে। বিশেষ করে মালয়েশিয়ার রেস্তোরাঁ ও পামওয়েল খাতসহ অন্যান্য সম্ভাবনাময় ক্ষেত্রে বাংলাদেশি কর্মীদের ব্যাপক চাহিদা তৈরি হওয়ায় দ্রুততম সময়ে কর্মী পাঠাতে উভয় দেশই নমনীয় ও ইতিবাচক নীতি অনুসরণে নীতিগতভাবে সম্মত হয়েছে। মালয়েশিয়া সরকারের শীর্ষ পর্যায়ের নির্দেশনার আলোকে অগ্রাধিকারপ্রাপ্ত খাতগুলোতে দ্রুত কর্মী নিয়োগের ব্যবস্থা নেওয়ার সিদ্ধান্ত হয়েছে। প্রাথমিকভাবে কর্মী পাঠানো শুরুর পর নিরাপত্তা ও অন্যান্য টেকনিক্যাল বিষয়গুলো পর্যায়ক্রমে সমাধান করা হবে বলে জানানো হয়। উভয় পক্ষই আশ্বস্ত করেছে যে, শ্রমবাজারের বর্তমান স্থবিরতা ও সংকট কাটিয়ে উঠতে এবং পারস্পরিক স্বার্থ রক্ষায় বাংলাদেশ ও মালয়েশিয়া সরকার অত্যন্ত গুরুত্বের সাথে যৌথভাবে কাজ করে যাচ্ছে।

⦿ लोक परीक्षा (अनुचित साधन निवारण) संशोधन विधेयक, 2026 का विवरण पढ़कर पता चलता है कि मोदी सरकार शिक्षा व्यवस्था को सुधारने के लिए गंभीर नहीं है ⦿ 2024 में भी सरकार ने इस बिल को ऐतिहासिक बताया था- लेकिन कुछ नहीं हुआ। ये कानून मोदी सरकार की विफलता का स्मारक है ⦿ NEET-UG 2024 पेपर लीक की तहकीकात में जिन 45 लोगों के खिलाफ चार्जशीट दाखिल की गई थी, उसमें से 44 लोगों को बेल मिल चुकी है- ये शर्मनाक है ⦿ जब 2024 में पेपर लीक हुआ था, तब भी धर्मेंद्र प्रधान सच्चाई मानने को तैयार नहीं थे और 2026 में भी उनका यही रवैया था ⦿ शर्म आनी चाहिए कि जिस मंत्री के रहते 21 बच्चों ने जान दे दी, मोदी सरकार उनका सम्मान करती है ⦿ परीक्षा में सुधार और पेपर लीक माफिया के खिलाफ कदम उठाने के बदले प्रधानमंत्री मोदी इंस्टाग्राम पर ध्यान देने को कहते हैं ⦿ RSS ने देश के शिक्षा संस्थानों पर कब्जा कर लिया है ⦿ युवा अपने अधिकारों के लिए दिल्ली में जुटे थे। आंदोलन में किसी को लाठी पड़ी, किसी का सिर फूट गया, लेकिन वे डिगे नहीं ⦿ इस आंदोलन में अगर हमने इंसानियत देखी तो दूसरी तरफ युवाओं पर बेरहमी से किए गए लाठीचार्ज को भी देखा ⦿ हम ये नहीं भूल सकते कि एक पुलिसवाले ने लड़की को थप्पड़ जड़ा, एक लड़की के प्राइवेट पार्ट में डंडा मारा। युवाओं पर पैलेट गन का इस्तेमाल किया ⦿ हमें जवाब दिया जाए कि किसने लाठीचार्ज, पैलेट गन और आंसू गैस के गोले छोड़ने का आदेश दिया? सरकार और गृह मंत्री अमित शाह को इसपर जवाब देना होगा : लोकसभा में 'लोक परीक्षा (अनुचित साधन निवारण) संशोधन विधेयक, 2026' पर कांग्रेस के उपनेता @GauravGogoiAsm जी का पूरा वक्तव्य- Video

The initiative represents an important step towards demonstrating how clean energy, sustainable agriculture, and community ownership can come together to create resilient and inclusive rural livelihoods. During the visit, the ICRIER team interacted with the on-ground PGPL team, farmers, and the EPC partner to gain a deeper understanding of the project's implementation status, validate key structural design aspects of the pilot, and discuss the upcoming milestones towards its successful commissioning. Hearing directly from the women farmers and witnessing their enthusiasm for the project reinforced the transformative potential of this model. در گزارش یوناما درباره‌ی وضعیت حقوق بشر آمده است که طالبان در هرات، دست‌کم ۱۷ نفر از معترضانی را که علیه بازداشت زنان و دختران به‌دلیل پوشش در منطقه‌ی جبرئیل هرات تظاهرات کرده بودند، بازداشت کرده‌اند. در این گزارش درباره‌ی سرنوشت افراد بازداشت‌شده توضیح داده نشده است. به‌تاریخ نهم جون، برابر با ۱۹ جوزا، شماری از باشندگان منطقه‌ی هزاره‌نشین جبرئیل در هرات علیه بازداشت زنان و دختران به‌دلیل چگونگی پوشش تظاهرات کردند. یوناما گفته است که این تظاهرات زمانی به خشونت کشید شد که نیروهای لباس‌شخصی طالبان شروع به لت‌وکوت و تیرانداری به‌سوی معترضان کردند.‌ در گزارش یوناما آمده است که نیروهای طالبان یک پسر را با شلیک گلوله کشتند و شماری از معترضان را مورد ضرب‌وشتم و تیراندازی قرار دادند که در نتیجه دست‌کم چهار نفر زخمی شدند. بیشتر بخوانید: etilaatroz.com/258123

دفتر هیأت معاونت سازمان ملل متحد (یوناما) در گزارش خود درباره‌ی وضعیت حقوق بشر گفته است که پس از بازداشت شماری از زنان به‌دلیل چگونگی پوشش توسط مأموران امر به معروف طالبان در هرات، حضور زنان در جاده‌های هرات به‌دلیل ترس از بازداشت کاهش یافته است. براساس این گزارش، از شش تا هشت ماه جون، مأموران امر به معروف طالبان در هرات دست‌کم ۳۰ زن و دختر را به‌دلیل نپوشیدن چادری بازداشت و به زندان انتقال دادند. این زنان و دختران در هشت جون پس از سپردن تعهد دوباره آزاد شدند. در گزارش یوناما آمده است که کارزار تطبیق حجاب مورد قبول طالبان در هرات از سال گذشته‌ی میلادی شروع شده بود و این گروه با ایجاد ایست‌های بازرسی، زنان بدون چادری را نگه می‌‌داشت تا بستگان آنان چادر بیاورند. بیشتر بخوانید: etilaatroz.com/258119

Secretary-General of ASEAN, Dr. Kao Kim Hourn, today briefed the diplomatic corps and the media, at the ASEAN Headquarters/ASEAN Secretariat, on the key outcomes of the 59th ASEAN Foreign Ministers’ Meeting (AMM), Post-Ministerial Conferences (PMC), 27th ASEAN Plus Three Foreign Ministers’ Meeting, 16th East Asia Summit Foreign Ministers’ Meeting, 33rd ASEAN Regional Forum, and Related Meetings, held in Manila, the Philippines. The series of meetings were held from 18 to 23 July 2026 and concluded with the commemorative events marking the 50th anniversary of the Treaty of Amity and Cooperation in Southeast Asia (TAC) on 24 July 2026, including the signing ceremony of the Instrument of Accession to the TAC for Lithuania, Sweden, Romania, and Poland, and the High-level Conference of the High Contracting Parties to the TAC. Representatives from ASEAN Committees in Third Countries and International Organisations (ACTCs) also participated in the briefing virtually. SG Dr. Kao shared the key outcomes of the meetings, emphasising ASEAN's continued central role in shaping the regional architecture, the enduring value of ASEAN-led mechanisms in fostering dialogue and cooperation, and the strong commitment of ASEAN's external partners to supporting the implementation of the ASEAN 2045: Our Shared Future. The series of meetings also laid the groundwork for the upcoming 49th ASEAN Summit and related Summits, to be held in Manila, in November this year. The Briefing was livestreamed to the public via the ASEAN Secretariat's YouTube channel.

A question keeps coming up in Indian tech circles — why doesn't India have its own Palantir? This piece argues it is the wrong question, and that the honest answer is more interesting than the one people expect. First, what Palantir actually is. - Strip away the spy-thriller image, and its real product is dull — software that takes an organisation's data, stored in twenty systems that don't talk to each other, and joins it into one view. - The US spy agencies had that fragmentation problem, so the CIA's venture arm funded a company to fix it. That's the origin. But here's the thing the piece points out. - India already built infrastructure of the same scale of ambition, in Aadhaar and UPI. And it did the exact opposite of Palantir. Palantir is a private company. - The US government hired it to build the system that connects all its scattered data, and over the years it has come to depend on that company completely. - It cannot easily replace it now. India did the reverse with UPI and Aadhaar. - The government built the core system itself and owns it. - Companies like PhonePe and Google Pay build apps that use it, but none of them owns the system underneath, so the government is not tied to any single one of them. An 'Indian Palantir' would mean a private company owning that core system. That is the opposite of how India has worked, so the piece argues it would not really fit. Still, India's army and police have the same problem Palantir was built for. Their data is spread across many agencies that do not share it with each other. So could an Indian company build something like Palantir just for defence? The piece says the real hurdle is not a shortage of engineers, or even money. It is trust. The government does not trust private companies enough to hand them work this sensitive. @AvadhanyGirish writes in @SwarajyaMag — India Doesn't Need A Palantir. On 6 February 1190, at least 17 children and adults were massacred in Norwich, England, perhaps by English Crusaders, and thrown down a well. In 2004 archaeologists dug up their skeletal remains. In 2020, BBC reported that researchers now had the technology to sequence the victims’ genome. The findings were published in that year’s issue of the journal Biology Today. The victims were found to be, genetically, Ashkenazi Jews. A very recent group, formed by tricklimg migrations of Jews northward from the western Mediterranean. In 2026, my own DNA was analyzed by a nonprofit DNA research lab. This week they let me know that three of the Norwich Massacre victims, three piles of bones pulled out of the well, a man, a young girl and a toddler boy, were my own very very distant relatives. I find this stunning. Also far too awe-inspiring and subtle for facile jokes or simplistic politics. Just one remark: state of the art genetics and identity politics, not to mention postcolonialist theories, are embarking on a roller coaster. New findings will affect not only our collective histories, but change the very texture of the stories we individually tell about ourselves. For the sadder, perhaps, but ultimately - as new vistas open for every aspect of our past - for the better too. bbc.com/news/uk-england-norf…

Prime Minister Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif's Message on the Occasion of World Hepatitis Day, 28 July 2026. On World Hepatitis Day, Pakistan joins the international community in reaffirming its unwavering commitment to eliminating hepatitis and protecting our people from this devastating disease. Pakistan remains among the countries with the highest burden of Hepatitis C and has been confronting this serious public health challenge for decades.Ensuring equitable access for every citizen to quality screening, diagnosis and treatment services for the prevention and control of the most severe and life threatening forms of hepatitis remains one of the Government's foremost priorities. Recognising that Hepatitis C is both preventable and curable, the Government of Pakistan launched the Prime Minister's National Programme for the Elimination of Hepatitis C Infection in 2025. This historic and unprecedented initiative aims to provide millions of Pakistanis with free and timely screening, confirmatory testing and effective treatment. Under this Programme's implementation, screening, diagnostic and treatment services have already commenced in Islamabad, with all major public healthcare facilities and hospitals actively participating. Furthermore, mobile screening has also been launched to ensure these essential services reach communities more effectively. Individuals requiring further diagnostic evaluation and treatment are being enrolled in the Programme without any financial burden. To curb the spread of this deadly disease, the Government has imposed a complete ban on the manufacture, distribution and reuse of substandard syringes. In this regard, strict directives have been issued to ensure compliance with infection prevention and hygiene protocols in hospitals and healthcare facilities, while accountability has been strengthened for any negligence in their implementation. The Federal Government remains committed to making the best possible use of available resources while further strengthening collaboration with provincial governments, development partners, healthcare professionals and the private sector to minimise the impact of this disease and ensure that no deserving patient is deprived of treatment. Success in the fight against hepatitis and other communicable diseases requires not only the Government's efforts but also the active participation of every individual and the wider community. I urge all Pakistanis to undergo timely Hepatitis C screening, encourage their family members, friends and colleagues to get tested, and adopt safe healthcare and hygiene practices that help prevent the spread of infection. Early diagnosis and prompt treatment save lives. Our doctors, nurses, laboratory professionals and frontline healthcare workers are at the forefront of this national effort to prevent and combat disease. Their dedication and service deserve our highest appreciation. I urge them to continue setting exemplary standards of professional excellence, commitment and compassion in the discharge of their duties. On this World Hepatitis Day, let us renew our pledge to build a healthier Pakistan. I am confident that through collective efforts, close cooperation, scientific innovation, public participation and the blessings of Almighty Allah, we will achieve our national commitment and global goal of eliminating Hepatitis C as a major public health threat by 2030, Insha'Allah. Pakistan Zindabad.

"Mainland Conducts First Fisheries Scientific Survey East of Taiwan [title] At midnight in mid-July, in the waters east of Taiwan Island, the *Lanhai 201*—a comprehensive fisheries scientific research vessel from the East China Sea Fisheries Research Institute (under the Chinese Academy of Fishery Sciences, Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs)—was a hive of activity. As the survey nets were slowly hoisted and the collected samples poured into baskets, a pungent, briny scent of the sea filled the air. Yet, Dr. Shi Yongchuang, an associate researcher at the institute, excitedly removed his mask and leaned in close to examine these small creatures from relatively unfamiliar waters. For the research team—whose members have an average age of just 35—this marked their first foray into this traditional fishing ground of Chinese fishermen. To them, this was a voyage carrying forward a historic mission. They also took pride in arriving in these waters under Chinese jurisdiction amidst "roiling waves." On July 23—seven days after the *Lanhai 201* set sail—the comprehensive scientific survey of resources and the environment in the waters east of Taiwan Island was officially announced. During those seven days, *Global Times* reporters accompanying the *Lanhai 201* on its pioneering voyage not only witnessed the beauty of these "ancestral waters" but also personally experienced harassment by external forces. Zheng Hanfeng, the chief scientist of the expedition and deputy director of the East China Sea Fisheries Research Institute, told reporters that the voyage's most significant milestone was filling the gap in fisheries surveys for the waters east of Taiwan, thereby completing the geographic coverage of scientific surveys regarding fisheries resources within my country's Exclusive Economic Zone. Scientific researchers aboard the *Lanhai 201* employ various technical methods to survey fishery resources and the marine environment in the waters off eastern Taiwan. (Photo by Hu Yuwei) "Fulfilling a mentor's wish: filling the blank spots on the coastal survey map" Working around the clock without sleep became the norm for the scientific team aboard the *Lanhai 201* over the course of seven days. Even after midnight, the deck and laboratories remained brightly lit. What truly excited the team were the successive hauls of the catch; much like opening "blind boxes," they eagerly anticipated a new surprise with every net brought aboard. Even with a small fish that might seem unremarkable to the average person, Dr. Zhao Guoqing and his colleagues from the East China Sea Fisheries Research Institute would meticulously identify and process the specimen. They measured body length and weight one by one, and carefully performed dissections to record the stage of gonad development and stomach fullness. Dr. Zhao explained to the *Global Times* reporter that these seemingly trivial basic biological parameters serve as the cornerstone for subsequent biodiversity analysis and resource assessment. Populations of the same fish species inhabiting different waters can exhibit significant differences in characteristics due to geographical isolation and environmental factors. Zhang Hanye, a researcher and leader of the fish study group, elaborated: "The waters off eastern Taiwan are particularly unique; the seabed features rare, precipitous drops—with depths plunging to between 3,000 and 5,000 meters—which contrasts sharply with the continental shelf characteristics of other domestic coastal areas, where depths typically range from a few dozen to a few hundred meters. Being able to collect firsthand data from these waters—which are part of our own coastal territory—gives us much greater confidence in our scientific analysis." Zhao Guoqing’s focus and dedication stem from a deep sense of mission. He shared a personal regret with the reporter: his mentor had once vied for the National Science and Technology Progress Award for his work on a survey of China's coastal fishery resources. However, on the map of survey stations created by the team at the time, one small area—the waters off eastern Taiwan—had remained blank. 'My teacher often said that our work would only be truly complete once we could conduct a scientific survey there. Now, I have finally fulfilled my teacher’s wish and filled the gap in the map of inshore fishery surveys. As a Chinese person, I feel truly proud at this moment.'" Global Times-China, 26 July

We have always supported open-weight models on Amazon Bedrock, starting back in 2023, and will continue to advocate for open ecosystems. No single model will define AI leadership. Together, they expand access to AI, accelerate innovation, strengthen competition, and give organizations greater control over the technology they build. Successful leadership in AI will not be built around a single model or a single approach. It will be built on broad choice and the infrastructure to run those models securely, reliably, and at scale. While there are elements of the Open Weights and American AI Leadership letter that need further definition over time, we’re supportive of the macro direction and have signed it.

If you wanted attention, DW, all you had to do was ask! In this pathetic documentary, the conclusion came first. Pakistan was then edited to fit it. The method is embarrassingly transparent: 1. Show a radical cleric. 2. Cut to a nuclear facility. 3. Add ominous music. 4. Mention instability. 5. Let insinuation replace evidence. Pakistan is described as having “illegally developed” nuclear weapons. Illegally under which law? Pakistan was never a party to the NPT and therefore did not violate an NPT obligation by acquiring nuclear weapons. DW may disapprove of the program, but moral disapproval is not a legal argument, Folks. Notice the asymmetry in language! India developed nuclear weapons. Pakistan “deceived the world.” India’s programme is treated as a strategic fact. Pakistan’s is narrated as criminal cunning. Mashallah! The documentary briefly mentions 1971, India’s conventional advantage and Pakistan’s loss of faith in external guarantees but refuses to let any of that seriously explain Pakistan’s nuclear choices. Context is included only so it can be ignored. Then comes the old “Islamists might seize the bomb” trope. No evidence of penetration of nuclear command structures is presented. No demonstrated breach is identified. No serious institutional assessment is offered. Just militants somewhere in Pakistan and therefore loose nukes. Even DW’s own interviewees acknowledge centralized command and control, multiple security layers and specialized forces protecting nuclear assets. But every reassuring fact is treated as an inconvenient interruption before the awful soundtrack returns to impending catastrophe. DW uses AQ Khan's case as a permanent substitute for analysing Pakistan’s present nuclear-security architecture. History becomes guilt without expiry, who knew! But that's not all! of course, there comes Kashmir, which is handled with similar intellectual laziness. Instead of seriously examining disputed sovereignty, war, repression, failed diplomacy and competing legal claims, Pakistan’s position is reduced to a psychological obsession arising from its Muslim identity. A retired brigadier making expansive comments about nuclear use is presented as a window into Pakistan’s doctrine. He is not the National Command Authority. He is not the Strategic Plans Division. He is not an official doctrinal document. But guess what! nuance would spoil the drama. The documentary also bundles together military businesses, hospitals, gated housing, blasphemy laws, Imran Khan, Afghan refugees, illegal weapons markets and attacks on Christians. These are serious issues. BUT they are not evidence that Pakistan’s nuclear arsenal is insecure. Here's the central fraud: collapsing four separate questions into one. -Pakistan’s democratic governance. -Its civil-military imbalance. -Its internal security challenges. -Its nuclear command and control. DW treats them as interchangeable because differentiation would require actual analysis. The final product is the standard Western Pakistan story: -Too poor to govern itself. -Too religious to be trusted. -Too militarized to be democratic. -Too unstable to possess nuclear weapons. Pakistan has serious problems. None of them should be denied or romanticized. But a credible documentary would distinguish between nuclear safety, nuclear security, political stability and democratic governance. It would examine institutions, procedures, doctrine and evidence. It would compare Pakistan with other nuclear powers. It would ask whether the risks it highlights are demonstrated, plausible or merely imagined. Strip away the ominous soundtrack and all that remains is a tired collection of stereotypes. The only real danger in this documentary is losing sixty minutes you will never get back. Statement by the CARICOM EPG on the Transmission of the Electoral Calendar The Eminent Persons Group (EPG) of the Caribbean Community (CARICOM) welcomes the publication of the electoral calendar by the Haitian Provisional Electoral Council (CEP). This critical step in the electoral process which provides the dates for the organisation of the general elections, has been eagerly awaited by Haitian stakeholders and also by the international community. The availability of the calendar will no doubt give a boost to the critical ongoing preparatory stages of the electoral process such as the registration of political parties, platforms and coalitions as well as the registration of voters. The EPG underlines the importance of the Provisional Electoral Council working closely with all stakeholders as the preparatory stages for the general elections unfold, and whose first round for the presidency and the legislature, as well as for constitutional reform, will take place on December 13, 2026. The EPG also urges all stakeholders to engage in the process and to assist in ensuring that all the requirements and procedures are fulfilled so that the Haitian people can, through free and credible elections, choose their government and secure the restoration of constitutional order. As highlighted by the CEP, improvements in the overall security situation are critical inputs for the success of the electoral process. More than one month after the devastating earthquakes in Venezuela, we remember those who lost their lives and stand in solidarity with the families and communities rebuilding after tremendous loss and suffering. Recovery efforts must be guided by transparency, accountability, and respect for human rights. Protecting vulnerable communities, ensuring access to information about those who remain missing, and delivering civilian-led humanitarian assistance are essential to an effective and equitable response. In this time of crisis, Venezuela needs democratic institutions capable of responding effectively, safeguarding human rights, and earning the confidence of the people as the country continues to face profound challenges. PROVEA (@_Provea) La falta de una respuesta oportuna del Estado tras el doblete sísmico del 24 de junio reafirmó las fallas estructurales de las instituciones en Venezuela: Ausencia de autoridades en primeras horas, miles de personas en total desasistencia, falta de planificación para refugios y la opacidad en el manejo de la información oficial son parte de una negligencia estatal. Como organización con memoria histórica, advertimos que no puede repetirse la separación forzada de familias, militarización de la atención y el monopolio estatal de la ayuda como lo ocurrido en Vargas en 1999. Exigimos al Estado venezolano transparencia sobre desaparecidos y pacientes pediátricos, protección diferenciada para grupos vulnerables, desmilitarización de la asistencia y retiro de SEBIN/DGCIM de los albergues, y participación real de la sociedad civil en la reconstrucción. La reconstrucción de Venezuela debe ser técnica, pero, sobre todo, democrática. Belgian authorities have arrested a woman who was interning at NATO's Supreme Headquarters Allied Powers Europe (SHAPE) in Mons, Belgium, on suspicion of espionage. The woman, a Canadian citizen of Chinese origin, was detained on Friday, and the Belgian Federal Public Prosecutor's Office announced the arrest on Saturday. Prosecutors suspect that she was spying for a third country and was a member of a criminal organization. Investigators conducted searches at both her home and her workplace at SHAPE. The investigation began when SHAPE's own security services flagged her conduct and reported their concerns to Belgian military intelligence, which subsequently referred the matter to federal prosecutors. SHAPE is NATO's primary military command in Europe, led by the Supreme Allied Commander Europe, and plays a central role in the alliance's operational planning. A SHAPE spokesperson stated that there is no indication that NATO's or SHAPE's operational readiness, command and control arrangements, or ongoing tasks have been affected, confirming that the headquarters continues to operate normally. Authorities have provided few additional details about the case. They have not publicly identified the woman or disclosed the country for which she allegedly spied. This arrest comes amid heightened concerns across Europe regarding foreign intelligence activities targeting NATO institutions and member states. Source: AP, Bloomberg, Washington Post, CBC, Global News. So What The identity of the sponsoring state has not been confirmed. While reports emphasize her Chinese origin, it’s important to note that origin alone is not evidence, and prosecutors have not named anyone specific. It's unlikely that a single intern represents the entire picture; additional handlers or a broader network may be involved. SHAPE, which is NATO's primary military command, is a probable target for any capable hostile service. Although she is individually accused of betraying her country, placing a source within a headquarters like this is standard tradecraft for hostile states, not an exception. The @CIDH (IACHR)'s landmark decision recognizing the Cuban state’s responsibility for abuses against @CubalexDDHH is an important victory for accountability and human rights defenders across the region. The findings expose the costs of Cuban repression and reaffirm that those documenting human rights abuses deserve protection, not persecution. #Cuba #HumanRights Cubalex (@CubalexDDHH) ⚖️ La Comisión Interamericana responsabiliza al Estado cubano por violaciones de derechos humanos contra la organización Cubalex El Centro de Información Legal Cubalex y el Robert & Ethel Kennedy Human Rights Center celebran la histórica decisión publicada hoy por la Comisión Interamericana de Derechos Humanos (CIDH), mediante la cual se declara la responsabilidad del Estado cubano por la vigilancia ilegal, el hostigamiento, la represión y la detención arbitraria de los abogados y el personal de la organización. Este fallo es el resultado de más de ocho años de litigio estratégico. La CIDH emitió múltiples recomendaciones obligatorias al Estado de Cuba, exigiendo la reparación integral a las víctimas —incluyendo compensación económica, medidas de satisfacción y condiciones para el retorno seguro de quienes fueron forzados al exilio—, la investigación y sanción de los funcionarios responsables, y la adopción de medidas legislativas y administrativas para erradicar la violencia y la criminalización contra defensores de derechos humanos. Desde su fundación en La Habana en 2010, Cubalex ha brindado asistencia jurídica gratuita y documentado abusos estatales, enfrentando por ello una severa persecución. Entre 2012 y 2016, sus miembros sufrieron detenciones bajo cargos fabricados, intervención de comunicaciones y restricciones de viaje. La represión escaló en septiembre de 2016 con un violento allanamiento sin orden judicial a su sede, donde se incautaron equipos y archivos, forzando al exilio a la mayor parte del equipo. El abogado Julio Ferrer Tamayo permaneció detenido arbitrariamente hasta 2017 y logró exiliarse en 2024. La CIDH concluyó que el régimen cubano violó los derechos a la privacidad, debido proceso, libertad de expresión, reunión, asociación, tránsito y protección contra el arresto arbitrario. Asimismo, determinó que el Estado provocó daños físicos y psicológicos intencionales en represalia directa por la labor de Cubalex, con el fin de impedir la defensa de los derechos humanos dentro de un marco jurídico y político que sigue siendo abiertamente represivo. #Cubalex #DerechosHumanos #CIDH #Justicia #Cuba #SOSCuba #RendiciónDeCuentas — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/CubalexDDHH/status/2079598428217110685#m

Russian media reports that Putin has signed a decree to increase the Russian Armed Forces by 27,000 military personnel starting August 1. The stated reason was the "creation of military-construction units," and of course, everyone believed it.

For the past six months, the Ukrainian 🇺🇦 army has been on the offensive along a 50-kilometer-wide front, gradually retaking villages lost the previous year. With no official statements and very few videos available, little is known about this "offensive." I have therefore gathered as much information as possible to discuss it. In 2025, the Russian army doubled its rate of advance compared to 2024. Yet, it was not in the Donbas that they were advancing the most. Very early in the year, they seized Velyka Novosilka and pushed north toward Komar and west toward Huliaipole. By the year's end, the situation for Ukraine was critical: defensive lines facing south had been overrun from the east, and the Russian army was steadily closing in on Zaporizhzhia, a city of 800,000 inhabitants. After the capture of Huliaipole, everyone expected Pokrovsk'e, Ternuvate (already infiltrated at the time), and then Orikhiv to fall, placing the Russian army at the gates of Zaporizhzhia by the end of the year. Yet, seven months later, the situation remained unchanged; the Russians are still stalled west of Huliaipole. Worse, they have lost significant territory further north, bringing a halt to this offensive, which, while secondary to the main Donbas campaign, had nonetheless committed a massive force, including five armies and an army corps. 🔸So, what happened? It began in February, when several air-assault brigades repositioned to the region, launched an armored assault under cover of fog, deploying their infantry into contested villages, often behind the initial Russian infiltrators. The villages were methodically cleared, and Ukrainian soldiers began infiltrating southward themselves. In March, they were positioned east and west of Uspenivka, blocking Russian attempts to advance toward Pokrovske and Ternuvate. In response to this offensive, the Russian army sends several naval infantry brigades and divisions, as well as the 68th Army Corps, as reinforcements. Starting in April, air assault brigades repositioned further north with the mission of advancing on Komar. The goal of this redeployment was to prevent the 90th Tank Division from shifting its assets toward Dobropilla. There was no mechanized offensive this time, as the terrain, specifically the presence of several rivers, most notably the Vovtcha, precluded it. Instead, small Ukrainian infantry groups managed to gradually infiltrate as far as the next river, the Mokri Yali. It is important to understand that, despite having been in the area for at least eight months, Russian forces had been unable to consolidate their positions; a network of rivers complicated logistics, and the small size of the villages made it impossible to concentrate large numbers of troops. Consequently, the Ukrainians were able to advance relatively stealthily behind enemy lines, reaching the Mokri Yali River. A strict information blackout was imposed in the area. Apart from a single video (since deleted) showing Ukrainian troops raising a flag over a liberated village, the Ukrainians released nothing regarding an operation that had already been underway for three months. For their part, the Russians continued to obscure the situation: the Vostok Group released only videos that were difficult to geolocate and persisted in sending "suicide" flag-bearers troops, who would reach Iskra and raise the Russian flag, creating an illusion of control. On the map, I have roughly depicted the situation as it has stood over the last few weeks, relying primarily on a handful of geolocated videos, satellite imagery showing air and artillery strikes, and scattered social media statements. Simply put, little is known about the actual state of the front, other than the fact that Ukrainian forces are at the gates of Komar, a move that has forced the 90th Tank Division to keep half its strength committed to that sector. What I am certain of is that all Russian troops positioned north of the Vovcha River (in Ivanivka) or the Solena (in Novopavlivka) have either been killed or captured, judging by the number of Russian air strikes, at least a hundred, carried out in the area. Consequently, the section of the "New Donbass Line" in this sector has held for the tenth consecutive month. It is certain that the Ukrainians have retaken control of the few villages to the south, given the air strikes observed in the zone. For the time being, I will respect Ukrainian OPSEC protocols and refrain from providing further details regarding an ongoing operation, as long as more confirmation are not coming. 🔸You might be wondering how such an operation is structured. The Ukrainians are making extensive use of drones to establish a wide exclusion zone in the sector, extending particularly along the river as far as Velyka Novosilka. The operation is proceeding cautiously, with small infantry teams advancing gradually, supported by artillery positioned in the woods to the west and occasional Ukrainian air strikes on Russian drone operator positions in Komar. Overall, it is important to understand that this operation is taking place because the Russian army is unable to bring reinforcements to the front. Furthermore, anti-tank ditches prevent any Russian mechanized or motorized assault aimed at delivering reinforcements. To understand the disarray within the local command, one need only look at its use of air power. Air strikes are being carried out daily deep behind the lines, as far as Prossiana and Chaplyne, 35 to 40 km from the front. While the goal is to hinder the Ukrainian presence, these strikes primarily highlight the ineffectiveness of Russian drones in the sector, particularly the Molniya models. To conclude, this operation not only gained time for Ukraine to further fortify the Pavlohrad direction, it is a direct push in the foot of Russian forces, which can continue further this summer and later in the autumn. I'll continue to monitor this and wait for more official informations regarding the situation here. Thank you for reading !

Elon Musk’s visible shock when confronted with the fact that London is safer than American cities exposes a massive gap between social media algorithms and statistical reality. Despite the endless stream of online panic about ”dangerous” European capitals, the numbers don’t lie: London is objectively safer than almost every city in the United States. The idea that London is a crime-ridden wasteland is a triumph of online disinformation, allowed to spread unchecked on platforms like X because it fits a specific political narrative. The actual data shows that London's homicide rate sits at roughly 1.1 per 100,000 people. To put that in perspective, 100 out of the 100 largest US cities (!!!) have higher homicide rates than London, and 49 out of 50 US states are more dangerous on this metric. London achieves this safety record despite being a massive, diverse global hub of nine million residents. Critics often point to property crime or phone snatching to argue that London is worse, but using petty crime to ignore murder statistics is fundamentally flawed. Criminologists rely heavily on homicide rates because non-fatal crime statistics are notoriously harder to compare and more unreliable. Theft, sexual violence, and minor assault reporting rates fluctuate wildly depending on how much citizens trust local police or whether they need a police report for an insurance claim. Forms of non-lethal violence also vary based on legislation: you will naturally see more stabbings in a country with fewer guns, and more gun violence in a country with more guns. Homicide, by contrast, is an absolute and objective metric. It measures the ultimate form of violence, correlates strongly with overall severe crime, and leaves almost no room for underreporting. It counts all forms of lethal violence in an unhackable way. It is impossible to claim your city is safer than London if you have a five times higher homicide rate, even if London scores worse on theft. London has plenty of room for improvement, but American commentators living under drastically higher murder rates should clean up their own backyard before preaching to others

पुणे शहर व परिसरातील वाहतूक कोंडी सोडविण्यासाठी महत्त्वपूर्ण प्रकल्पांना गती मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांच्या अध्यक्षतेखाली आज सह्याद्री अतिथीगृह, मुंबई येथे पुण्यातील प्रमुख शहरी वाहतूक प्रकल्पांच्या नियोजन, वित्तीय व्यवस्थापन, अंमलबजावणी आणि देखरेखीसाठी गठित उच्चस्तरीय समितीची बैठक पार पडली. पुणे शहर व परिसरातील वाहतूक कोंडी दूर करण्यासाठी उच्चक्षमता सामूहिक वाहतूक मार्ग (एचसीएमटीआर), पुणे अंतर्गत रिंग रोड आणि बोगद्यांचे जाळे हे तीन महत्त्वपूर्ण प्रकल्प राबविण्यात येणार आहेत. या प्रकल्पांसाठी शासकीय जमिनींचा आगाऊ ताबा, भूसंपादन आणि प्रकल्पनिहाय प्रशासकीय प्रक्रिया समन्वयाने पूर्ण करून संबंधित पायाभूत सुविधा प्रकल्पांना गती देण्याचे निर्देश मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी दिले. उच्चक्षमता सामूहिक वाहतूक मार्ग (एचसीएमटीआर) हा पुण्याच्या भविष्यातील दीर्घकालीन विकासाच्यादृष्टीने परिवर्तनकारी पायाभूत सुविधा प्रकल्प आहे. एचसीएमटीआर आणि बोगदा प्रकल्प पुणे शहर अधिक कार्यक्षम, वाहतूकसुलभ आणि आर्थिकदृष्ट्या सक्षम बनविण्यात महत्त्वाची भूमिका बजावणार आहेत. या तीनही प्रकल्पांसाठी आवश्यक असलेली शासकीय जमीन पुणे महापालिका आणि पुणे महानगर प्रदेश विकास प्राधिकरण (PMRDA) यांना उपलब्ध करून देण्यासाठी एकत्रित शासन निर्णय काढण्याबाबत प्रस्ताव सादर करावा, तसेच रिंग रोड प्रकल्पासाठी आवश्यक खासगी जमिनीचे भूसंपादन रोख मोबदल्याद्वारे पूर्ण करावे, असे निर्देश मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी दिले. पुणे शहरातील वाहतूक कोंडी कमी करण्यासाठी उच्चक्षमता सामूहिक वाहतूक मार्ग (एचसीएमटीआर) प्रकल्प अत्यंत उपयुक्त ठरणार आहे. 43.60 किमी लांबीच्या या प्रकल्पामुळे शहरातील वाहतूक 25 ते 30% कमी होण्यास मदत होणार आहे. या प्रकल्पामुळे सर्व मेट्रो मार्गिका एकमेकांशी जोडल्या जाणार असून रस्त्यांची वाहतूक क्षमता वाढणार आहे. त्यामुळे एचसीएमटीआर प्रकल्पाचे काम लवकर सुरू करून 2028 पर्यंत पूर्ण करण्यात यावे, यासाठी आर्थिक मॉडेल तयार करून प्रस्ताव सादर करण्याचे निर्देश मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी दिले. मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, PMRDA मार्फत राबविण्यात येणारा अंतर्गत रिंग रोड प्रकल्प 83.12 किमी लांबीचा असून त्यामध्ये 44 गावांचा समावेश आहे. हा प्रकल्प 5 टप्प्यांत राबविण्यात येणार असून, त्यासाठीची प्रक्रिया येत्या 6 ते 7 महिन्यांत पूर्ण करावी, तसेच, रोख मोबदल्याद्वारे भूसंपादनाची प्रक्रिया पूर्ण करण्याच्या सूचनाही त्यांनी दिल्या. पुणे शहरातील वाहतूक कोंडी सोडविण्यासाठी 'पाताळलोक' प्रकल्पांतर्गत शहरात 3 ठिकाणी बोगदे उभारण्यात येणार आहेत. यामध्ये भोसरी ते उंदरी नवीन विमानतळ (36 किमी, त्यापैकी 10 किमी एलिव्हेटेड), रामनदी-भूगाव ते राजाराम पूल (8 किमी) आणि तळजाई टेकडी ते पद्मावती-हिंगणे (1.65 किमी) या बोगद्यांचा समावेश आहे. या बोगद्यांच्या जाळ्याचा अभ्यास करण्यासाठी तज्ज्ञ संस्था अथवा तज्ज्ञांची मदत घेऊन सर्वंकष सर्वेक्षण करण्याच्या सूचना मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी दिल्या. तसेच, PMRDA च्या प्रस्तावित नगररचना (TPS) योजनांसंदर्भातही बैठकीत चर्चा करण्यात आली. PMRDA आणि पुणे महानगरपालिकेच्या 15 नगररचना योजना प्रस्तावित असून, त्या रद्द करण्यासंदर्भात PMRDA ने आपल्या स्तरावर प्रस्ताव तयार करून शासनाकडे सादर करावा, असे निर्देश मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी दिले. उच्चक्षमता सामूहिक वाहतूक मार्ग (एचसीएमटीआर) वैशिष्ट्ये : ▪️एकूण अंदाजे 36 किमी लांबीचा सहा पदरी उन्नत मार्ग. ▪️पुणे शहरातील मध्यवर्ती नागरी भागातून मार्ग जाणार. ▪️प्रकल्पाचा अपेक्षित खर्च – बांधकामासाठी सुमारे ₹9000 कोटी आणि भूसंपादनासाठी सुमारे ₹3000 कोटी. ▪️सार्वजनिक वाहतूक व्यवस्थेशी एकात्मीकरण. ▪️एचसीएमटीआरची पॅकेजेस – बोपोडी ते सिंहगड रस्ता (10.5 किमी), सिंहगड रस्ता ते सोलापूर रस्ता (13.2 किमी), सोलापूर रस्ता ते एअरपोर्ट चौक (10.21 किमी) आणि एअरपोर्ट चौक ते बोपोडी (9.17 किमी). PMRDA अंतर्गत रिंग रोडची वैशिष्ट्ये : ▪️प्रकल्पाचा एकूण खर्च ₹25,159.88 कोटी. ▪️टप्पा 1 – सोळू इंटरचेंज ते वडगाव शिंदे (महापालिका हद्द) 4.70 किमी, लोहगाव (महापालिका हद्दीपासून) ते वाघोली 7.56 किमी. ▪️टप्पा 2 – वाघोली ते कदमवाक वस्ती 9.36 किमी. ▪️टप्पा 3 – कदमवाक वस्ती ते जांभूळवाडी 21.48 किमी. ▪️टप्पा 4 – जांभूळवाडी ते भूगाव 14.21 किमी. ▪️टप्पा 5 – भूगाव ते परंदवाडी 25.80 किमी. यावेळी उपमुख्यमंत्री एकनाथ शिंदे, उपमुख्यमंत्री सुनेत्रा अजित पवार, राज्यमंत्री माधुरी मिसाळ व वरिष्ठ अधिकारी उपस्थित होते. @Dev_Fadnavis @mieknathshinde @SunetraA_Pawar @madhurimisal #Maharashtra #DevendraFadnavis #UrbanMobility

H.E. Mr. Jiang Zaidong, Ambassador of the People's Republic of China, called on Prime Minister Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif at the Prime Minister House in Islamabad on 27 July 2026

Islamabad: 27 July 2026. H.E. Mr. Jiang Zaidong, Ambassador of the People's Republic of China, called on Prime Minister Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif at the Prime Minister House today. Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Sen. Mohammad Ishaq Dar, Federal Minister for Planning, Development and Special Initiatives Ahsan Iqbal, Advisor to the Prime Minister Dr. Syed Tauqir Shah and Foreign Secretary Amb. Amna Baloch were also present. The Prime Minister conveyed his warm regards and greetings to President Xi Jinping and Premier Li Qiang. He reaffirmed the Pakistan-China All Weather Strategic Cooperative Partnership, while fondly recalling his visit to China in May this year. He stated that both sides would continue working closely to implement the important decisions and agreements between the leadership of the two countries, for the mutual benefit of their peoples. The regional situation, including developments in the Middle East, Afghanistan and South Asia, were also discussed during the meeting. The Chinese Ambassador thanked the Prime Minister for receiving him and said that China regarded Pakistan as an iron brother and would always lend its full support in ensuring Pakistan's sovereignty and territorial integrity while also strengthening its socio-economic development Video

प्रकल्पासंदर्भात' आढावा बैठक पार पडली. पालघर जिल्ह्यातील देवळी परिसरात होत असलेल्या गारगाई प्रकल्पामुळे मुंबई शहराच्या पाणी उपलब्धतेमध्ये वाढ होणार आहे. या प्रकल्पाशी संबंधित पुनर्वसन, वनीकरण आणि प्रकल्पाच्या उभारणीला गती देण्यात आली असून, मे 2029 पर्यंत प्रकल्प कार्यान्वित करण्याचे उद्दिष्ट निश्चित करण्यात आले आहे. गारगाई धरण प्रकल्प पूर्ण झाल्यानंतर मुंबई महानगर क्षेत्राच्या दीर्घकालीन पाणीपुरवठ्याला बळकटी मिळण्यास मदत होणार आहे. 658 हेक्टर बुडीत क्षेत्रात वनजमीन जात असल्याने 1400 हेक्टर जमीन पुनर्वसनासाठी उपलब्ध करून दिली जाणार आहे. तसेच बुडीत वनक्षेत्रासाठी वनविकासाकरिता वन विभागाला राज्यातील विविध जिल्ह्यांमध्ये जमीन देण्यात येत आहे. या प्रकल्पासाठी सुमारे 844 हेक्टर जमीन बाधित होणार असून, त्यामध्ये 186 हेक्टर खासगी जमीन आणि 658 हेक्टर वनजमिनीचा समावेश आहे. प्रकल्पाच्या बुडीत क्षेत्रात एकूण 805 हेक्टर जमीन येणार आहे. प्रकल्पामुळे ओगदा आणि खोडदे ही दोन गावे पूर्णतः, तर पाचघर, तिळमाळ, फणसगाव आणि आमले ही 4 गावे अंशतः बाधित होणार आहेत. या महत्त्वाकांक्षी प्रकल्पाचा अंदाजित खर्च ₹3065 कोटी असून, त्यामध्ये धरण, जलबोगदा, पुनर्वसनासाठी आवश्यक 22 पायाभूत सुविधांची निर्मिती तसेच वीज निर्मिती संचाचा समावेश आहे. याशिवाय जमीन अधिग्रहण, पुनर्वसन, पर्यायी वनीकरण, वृक्षांचे राष्ट्रीय भूकंप संकल्पन मानक समिती यांच्यासह गारगाई धरण प्रकल्पाच्या संकल्पचित्रास तांत्रिक मंजुरी आणि पर्यावरणीय परवानग्या प्राप्त झाल्या आहेत. राष्ट्रीय वन्यजीव महामंडळाच्या मंजुरीसाठी कार्यवाही कारगिल वीरांचे शौर्य भारताच्या इतिहासात अजरामर राज्यपाल जिष्णू देव वर्मा आणि मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांनी आज लोकभवन, मुंबई येथे 'कारगिल विजय दिवसा'निमित्त वीरसैनिक व वीरसैनिकांच्या वीरपत्नींचा कृतज्ञता सन्मान सोहळा येथे प्रमुख उपस्थिती दर्शविली. कारगिल युद्धात भारतीय जवानांनी अत्यंत प्रतिकूल परिस्थितीत दाखविलेले शौर्य हे जगाच्या युद्ध इतिहासातील अतुलनीय उदाहरण असून, भारताचा इतिहास जिवंत असेपर्यंत कारगिलचे वीर अजरामर राहतील, असे प्रतिपादन मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी केले. मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, कारगिल युद्धात शत्रू उंच पर्वतरांगांवर तळ ठोकून बसला असतानाही भारतीय लष्कर, हवाई दल आणि नौदलाने अद्वितीय समन्वय आणि पराक्रमाचे दर्शन घडवून एक-एक चौकी पुन्हा ताब्यात घेत भारताला ऐतिहासिक विजय मिळवून दिला. गोळीबार, बॉम्बहल्ले आणि अत्यंत कठीण भौगोलिक परिस्थितीची पर्वा न करता भारतीय जवानांनी दाखविलेल्या शौर्याला तोड नाही. कॅप्टन सौरभ कालिया, कॅप्टन विक्रम बत्रा, कॅप्टन मनोज कुमार पांडे यांसारख्या अधिकाऱ्यांनी मातृभूमीच्या रक्षणासाठी सर्वोच्च बलिदान दिल्याचे स्मरण करून मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, देशासाठी प्राणार्पण करणाऱ्या या वीरांचे योगदान भारत कधीही विसरणार नाही. आपल्या वीरांचा सन्मान करणारा समाजच उज्ज्वल भविष्य घडवू शकतो. मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, सैन्यातील जवान तर मातृभूमीच्या स्वाभिमानासाठी लढत असतात, त्यामुळे शहीद झाल्यानंतर त्यांच्या कुटुंबीयांना संपूर्ण देश त्यांच्या पाठीशी असल्याची जाणीव करून देणे ही प्रत्येक नागरिकाची जबाबदारी आहे. 2014 मध्ये शहीद जवानांच्या कुटुंबीयांना दिल्या जाणाऱ्या आर्थिक मदतीत मोठी वाढ करण्याचा निर्णय घेतला. सुरुवातीला ₹3,00,000 असलेली मदत टप्प्याटप्प्याने वाढवून 2017 पासून महाराष्ट्रातील प्रत्येक शहीद जवानाच्या कुटुंबाला ₹1 कोटींपर्यंत वाढवली. शहीदांच्या बलिदानाचे मोल पैशात होऊ शकत नसले तरी राज्य शासन त्यांच्या कुटुंबियांच्या पाठीशी कायम उभे राहील, अशी ग्वाही मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी दिली. भारताने संरक्षण क्षेत्रात आत्मनिर्भरतेकडे मोठी झेप घेतल्याचे नमूद करत मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, पंतप्रधान नरेंद्र मोदी यांच्या नेतृत्वाखाली भारत आज केवळ शस्त्रास्त्र आयात करणारा देश राहिलेला नसून अत्याधुनिक शस्त्रास्त्रांची निर्मिती आणि निर्यात करणारा सक्षम देश बनला आहे. 'ऑपरेशन सिंदूर'च्या माध्यमातून भारतीय सशस्त्र दलांनी दहशतवाद्यांचे तळ आणि शत्रूची लष्करी ठिकाणे उद्ध्वस्त करून देशाच्या सामरिक सामर्थ्याची जगाला प्रचिती दिली. राज्याच्या नागरिकांना सुरक्षित वातावरण लाभण्यामागे सीमेवर अहोरात्र देशरक्षण करणाऱ्या सैनिकांचे योगदान असल्याचे स्पष्ट करत मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी सर्व शहीदांना विनम्र अभिवादन केले. तसेच वीरसैनिक, वीरपत्नी आणि त्यांच्या कुटुंबियांप्रती कृतज्ञता व्यक्त करून महाराष्ट्र शासन भारतीय सशस्त्र दलांच्या पाठीशी सदैव ठामपणे उभे राहील, हे मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी अधोरेखित केले. यावेळी उपमुख्यमंत्री एकनाथ शिंदे, उपमुख्यमंत्री सुनेत्रा अजित पवार, मंत्री ॲड. आशिष शेलार, मंत्री शंभूराज देसाई, व्हाइस ॲडमिरल संजय वात्सायन, पीव्हीएसएम, एव्हीएसएम, एनएम (पश्चिम नौदल कमांडचे फ्लॅग ऑफिसर कमांडिंग-इन-चीफ), भारतीय लष्कराचे लेफ्टनंट जनरल डी. एस. कुशवाह, एव्हीएसएम, एसएम (जनरल ऑफिसर कमांडिंग, मुख्यालय महाराष्ट्र, गुजरात व गोवा), भारतीय सेनेतील व पोलीस दलातील वरिष्ठ अधिकारी, वीरसैनिक, वीरपत्नी, शहीद सैनिकांचे कुटुंबीय व इतर मान्यवर उपस्थित होते. @narendramodi @maha_governor @Dev_Fadnavis @mieknathshinde @SunetraA_Pawar @ShelarAshish @shambhurajdesai #Maharashtra #DevendraFadnavis #KargilVijayDiwas
